title: Pokemon TCG Volcanion Perfect Order 025/088 Reverse Holofoil Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Volcanion Uncommon ME03: Perfect Order 025/088 Reverse Holo card is a collectible card from the Pokémon Trading Card Game. This Water-type card features the character Volcanion with a Perfect creature type, illustrated by nagimiso. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States, this English-language card has a rare Uncommon rarity and a shiny Reverse Holofoil finish, making it a sought-after addition for collectors and players alike.
